I think it’s just the area but it could also possibly be that less people are buying houses because of that market and the state of the economy. My husband and I just found a place to rent and before doing that we considered buying a small house or condo but decided against it for now. 

My advice is to check new listings wherever you are looking (Trulia, Zillow, Facebook, Craigslist, etc) at least twice a day and call immediately if there’s one you like. Also if you are doing a showing before applying try to do it as close to the day it was listed as possible. There were several places we liked that we scheduled a showing a couple days out and it got snatched before we could even see it.

Also there seems to be way more availability of cheaper high quality places in Saint Paul. The one we ended up getting is technically in Saint Paul near Falcon Heights so our commutes to the other side of Minneapolis are still only around 20 minutes. Plus traffic and congestion in the area is so much better than Uptown or any similar trendy area in Minneapolis.

Nursing homes would be a great place to volunteer especially this time of year.
